chunks: Do not harvest at night, do not reap at night, do not cut at night, do not sacrifice at night, and do not sow at night, because you give at the time of sowing just as you give at the time of harvest. Whenever you do that at night, the needy, the beggars, the content poor, and the one who comes asking will not be present before you.

key_terms.الْقَانِعُ: the poor person who is content with what is given
key_terms.الْمُعْتَرُّ: the one who comes forward seeking provision

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام forbid harvesting and sowing at night?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that agricultural and related acts should not be done at night so that the poor and those who seek assistance may be present and receive their due. It emphasizes social responsibility and openness in acts connected to livelihood, giving, and provision.
